ideas.pitch: A modular solo developer state machine builder designed to rapidly restructure app logic when hit by surprise project requirement changes.
ideas.problem_statement: Grevix AfterCode is a 24-hour online solo hackathon where original plans are disrupted by unexpected challenges every 8 hours, testing adaptation under pressure.
ideas.title: AdaptFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the unique structural twist of the AfterCode Challenge System, showcasing a tool built specifically to help solo developers pivot architectures instantly during mid-hackathon disruptions.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered autonomous coding assistant that analyzes new Challenge Cards injected during a hackathon and automatically generates refactoring patches for the existing codebase.
ideas.problem_statement: Grevix AfterCode is a 24-hour online solo hackathon where participants receive unexpected Challenge Cards requiring core feature modifications, target user shifts, or constraint changes.
ideas.title: Pivoter Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages AI code generation to solve the exact pain point of the hackathon's multi-phase disruption mechanism, proving high utility for solo builders racing against strict time limits.

ideas.pitch: A solo builder task-scoping and time-blocking dashboard that dynamically recomputes deliverables and drops non-essential features when requirements change mid-project.
ideas.problem_statement: Grevix AfterCode is a 24-hour online solo hackathon requiring solo participants to efficiently manage their time across three 8-hour phases while handling abrupt scope changes.
ideas.title: FlexiScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes practical project management and rapid scoping strategy, demonstrating a working live demo that helps solo developers survive high-pressure time crunches.

ideas.pitch: A rapid mock backend generator with live endpoint hot-swapping designed for solo developers whose API requirements change unexpectedly during a hackathon.
ideas.problem_statement: Grevix AfterCode is a 24-hour online solo hackathon where participants must frequently adapt their data models and interaction flows due to unexpected challenge constraints.
ideas.title: ModularMock API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a universal bottleneck for solo hackers having to rewrite backend schemas on the fly when rules change, offering a clean, working utility product with clear measurable time savings.

ideas.pitch: A git-integrated checkpoint visualizer that helps solo builders branch, compare, and rollback architecture states before and after unexpected hackathon challenge injections.
ideas.problem_statement: Grevix AfterCode is a 24-hour online solo hackathon divided into 3 phases where original plans are disrupted and developers must effectively manage codebases under shifting constraints.
ideas.title: PatchPilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on clean developer ergonomics and clean version control management under strict time limits, aligning with what judges look for in disciplined solo execution.
